Telegram Link Generator

Build Telegram t.me profile links and share links with pre-filled text from any username or channel name.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a Telegram username, channel or bot name.
  2. Add an optional message for the share link.
  3. Copy the profile link, the share link, or open them to test.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a t.me link?

t.me is Telegram's official short domain. t.me/username opens that user, bot or channel directly in the app or web client.

Do I include the @ sign?

Type the username without the @. The tool strips it automatically if you include it.

What is the share link for?

The share link (t.me/share/url) opens Telegram's share sheet with your text pre-filled, letting the user pick who to send it to.

Is this private?

Yes — everything is generated locally in your browser.
